questions.q: A father and his son are in a car accident. The father dies at the scene, and the son is rushed to the hospital in critical condition. The surgeon looks at the boy and says, 'I can't operate on him — he's my son.' How is this possible?
choices: The father secretly survived and is the surgeon.
The surgeon is the boy's mother.
The boy has two adoptive fathers.
This is a logical contradiction with no answer.

questions.q: A woman 'shoots' her husband, then holds him under water for five minutes, then hangs him. Immediately afterward, they enjoy a nice dinner together. How is this possible?
choices: She develops a photograph of him — 'shoots' with a camera, 'holds' the film underwater to develop it, and 'hangs' it up to dry.
She is a ghost and none of it really happened.
She used a time machine to undo it.
It's all a dream she is having.

An ant starts crawling from one end of a 1 km rubber band at a constant 1 cm/s. At the end of every second, the entire band is instantly and uniformly stretched by another 1 km. Does the ant ever reach the far end?
choices: No — the band stretches far faster than the ant can crawl, so it falls further behind every second
Yes — the ant's fractional progress each second forms a divergent harmonic series, so it eventually covers the whole band
It depends on exactly where on the band the ant starts
No — the ant can only reach the end once the stretching stops

choices: Yes — go, but only to demand a partial refund at the door
Yes — you should go anyway, or the $50 is wasted
